description: v1.18 REL-04 variant of venues_xnas_iexg.json for the B8 v2 run (the v1 file is unchanged and still reproduces the published v1.17 B8 JSONs). Only change: IEXG carries inbound_delay_ns = 350000, IEX's published 350 microsecond speed bump (applied to every order and cancel; no jitter draw). The venue legs latency.mean_ns / jitter_ns stay 0 because NO order-entry latency has been measured for either venue (the IEX feed capture timestamp bounds feed latency only, with an unidentified clock offset; see docs/EXECUTION_QUALITY.md section 10): the internal decision/risk/wire legs of ExecConfig.latency (200 us) apply to both. A different assumption must be declared in the pre-declaration BEFORE the run. Fees are indicative list prices as in v1.
